_note: What you see: Nextcloud admin settings, Hermiq: AI providers (commercial, subscription, Ollama local, OpenAI compatible, Responses API, Nextcloud task processing), key vault, fallback and multiple models, cache, Talk bridge, web search, CLI runner and tracing to Langfuse.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Nextcloud-beheerinstellingen, Hermiq: AI-aanbieders (commercieel, abonnement, Ollama lokaal, OpenAI-compatibel, Responses API, Nextcloud-taakverwerking), sleutelkluis, terugval en meerdere modellen, cache, Talk-brug, webzoeken, CLI-runner en tracering naar Langfuse.
Commerciële aanbieders, een lokaal model: Commercial providers, a local model, any OpenAI-compatible address, Nextcloud's own task processing or a subscription. Agents choose from these; the model policy per organisation limits the choice.

Modelsleutels staan hier centraal en ver: Model keys are kept here centrally and encrypted, not in an agent. An agent only gets a key during a run.
